answer: Each identity binds a verified freelance profile: 12 months, 20 contracts, 2,000 dollars, record in the Reef Registry. A 30 POA anchor bond locks 120 days; a second from one cluster locks 60, a third 120, doubling to 960. Forging 100 profiles means 2,000 fake contracts, 200,000 dollars, 40,000 dollars in fees and 3,000 POA in bonds; each extra profile lifts the cluster bond. Each epoch a yarrow check re-attests every profile within 72 hours; two misses halve the bond and halt payouts 3 epochs, and a reused profile voids both bonds. On leave, a platform pause note plus a doubled bond suffices.
